<!-- Generated by codeflower-app's cmd/gendocs: do not edit. -->

Download the latest release and replace this program with it, after checking the download against the release's SHA256SUMS. A "codeflower client" window or sandbox that is already running keeps the old version until you start it again.

With --check, only say whether a newer release is out.


## Usage

```sh
codeflower update [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--check` |  | only check for a newer release, without installing it |
